source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: An applicant under eighteen who fails the knowledge exam must wait fifteen days to retake it, and anyone who fails three times must pass the classroom part of driver education or an approved eight hour manual course with completion after the third failure before trying a fourth time.
corrections.note: Added the eight hour manual course alternative to the classroom requirement.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you need glasses or contact lenses to pass the vision screening you must wear them when you drive and your license shows C, and a daylight only license allows driving only from a half hour after sunrise to a half hour before sunset.
corrections.note: Added half hour buffers and removed regardless of correction.

corrections.corrected_statement: You may turn right on red after a complete stop and yielding to pedestrians and other traffic unless a No Turn on Red sign is posted or a red arrow pointing right is displayed and you may turn left on red only from a one way street onto another one way street after a complete stop and yielding to pedestrians and other traffic unless a No Turn on Red sign is posted or a red arrow pointing left is displayed.
corrections.note: Added the stop yield and No Turn on Red and red arrow exceptions for both turns.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must stop and remain stopped for a steady red arrow unless a sign at the intersection allows Right on Red Arrow After Stop or Left on Red Arrow After Stop and at a flashing red arrow you must come to a complete stop and yield before proceeding when the way is clear.
corrections.note: Added the posted sign exception that permits turns on a steady red arrow.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you have not entered the intersection on a steady yellow light or arrow you must stop unless it is unsafe to stop and if you are already in the intersection you must go through it cautiously without speeding up to beat the light and at a flashing yellow light you must slow down and proceed with caution.
corrections.note: Added the unsafe to stop and already in intersection cautious go allowances.

corrections.corrected_statement: At a steady red light you must come to a complete stop and remain stopped as long as the signal is red unless turns are allowed and at a flashing red light you must come to a complete stop and yield to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians before going when the way is clear.
corrections.note: Added the unless turns are allowed exception to remaining stopped.

corrections.corrected_statement: A pedestrian crossing means slow down and be prepared to stop for people walking or riding in your path while a bicycle crossing means drive with caution where bikes cross or ride beside traffic and either spot may be marked by a second sign with an arrow.
corrections.note: Fixed bicycle meaning from slow and prepare to stop to drive with caution.

corrections.corrected_statement: A pedestrian crossing means slow down and be prepared to stop, a bicycle crossing means drive with caution, and a school zone means be ready to slow down or stop while obeying the speed limit and signals from crossing guards.
corrections.note: Fixed bicycle meaning from slowing and stopping readiness to drive with caution.

corrections.corrected_statement: A sharp right turn and a sharp right then left turn mean slow down and be prepared for a sharp turn while a right then left curve means slow down.
corrections.note: Right and Left Curves says only slow down, not be prepared.

corrections.corrected_statement: Sit straight but relaxed and place your hands at eight o clock and four o clock holding the wheel with your fingers and thumbs and avoiding gripping it with your palms.
corrections.note: Removed three and nine and airbag claims not on page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Every time you get behind the wheel you accept responsibility for your actions and must obey Virginia traffic laws and ensure safety.
corrections.note: No crash statistics appear on provided pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: A speed limit is the maximum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
corrections.note: No speeding death share or twenty to forty claim on pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: By law you must drive slower where signs indicate a school zone speed limit or work zone speed limit is in effect.
corrections.note: No guardrail or intrusion distance claim on pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: Obey every posted limit and drive slower in school and work zones and when road construction or bad weather make the posted speed unsafe.
corrections.note: Removed local ordinances not mentioned on page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Unless a sign states otherwise the maximum is twenty five miles per hour for school business and residential areas and thirty five for unpaved roads and fifty five for all other roads.
corrections.note: Added missing twenty five limit and removed school bus cap.

corrections.corrected_statement: By law you must drive slower where signs indicate a school zone speed limit or work zone speed limit is in effect and when road construction or bad weather make the posted speed unsafe.
corrections.note: Moved to page sixteen and removed rain fog and traffic list.

corrections.corrected_statement: You may drive slower than the speed limit as long as you do not impede the normal movement of traffic.
corrections.note: Removed move over and match pace claim.

corrections.corrected_statement: Three factors determine stopping distance which are perception time and reaction distance and braking distance.
corrections.note: Corrected two factors to three and removed fifty five claim.

corrections.corrected_statement: Wet pavement can double your braking distance.
corrections.note: Changed total stopping to braking and removed snow claim.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must always stop your vehicle at all stop signs and red traffic lights and flashing red signals.
corrections.note: Replaced no stopping claim with must stop list.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must stop for a stopped school bus with flashing red lights and an extended stop sign when you approach from any direction unless you are traveling in the opposite direction on a roadway with a median or barrier dividing the road.
corrections.note: Removed forty five school bus maximum not on page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Unless a sign states otherwise the maximum is twenty five miles per hour for school business and residential areas.
corrections.note: No playground fifteen or darting children on pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: Sit straight but relaxed and place your hands at eight o clock and four o clock holding the wheel with your fingers and thumbs and avoiding gripping it with your palms.
corrections.note: Removed three and nine and airbag zone claims.

corrections.corrected_statement: Unless a sign states otherwise the maximum is twenty five miles per hour for school business and residential areas and thirty five for unpaved roads and fifty five for all other roads.
corrections.note: Added missing twenty five limit and removed bus cap.

corrections.corrected_statement: A speed limit is the maximum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
corrections.note: No twenty to forty or wall impact claims on pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: A speed limit is the maximum legal speed under ideal conditions and you must drive slower in school and work zones and when road construction or bad weather make the posted speed unsafe.
corrections.note: Removed local ordinances not mentioned on page.

corrections.corrected_statement: By law you must drive slower where signs indicate a school zone speed limit or work zone speed limit is in effect and when road construction or bad weather make the posted speed unsafe.
corrections.note: Moved to page sixteen and removed detailed weather list.

corrections.corrected_statement: You may drive slower than the speed limit as long as you do not impede the normal movement of traffic.
corrections.note: Removed move over claim and kept impede rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Three factors determine stopping distance which are perception time and reaction distance and braking distance and wet pavement can double braking distance.
corrections.note: Corrected to three factors and braking only with no snow rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Unless a sign states otherwise the maximum is twenty five miles per hour for school business and residential areas.
corrections.note: No forty five bus cap or playground limits on pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection and when entering a roadway from a private road or driveway stop and yield to all traffic and pedestrians.
corrections.note: Removed parking areas which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: When the way is clear to make a left turn yield to any vehicles approaching from the opposite direction.
corrections.note: Removed green arrow rule which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: When entering a roadway from a private road or driveway you must stop and yield to all traffic and pedestrians.
corrections.note: Removed parking lots and parking areas which page eighteen does not state.

corrections.corrected_statement: When vehicles arrive at the same time at an intersection with no signs or signals the driver on the left must allow the driver on the right to go first.
corrections.note: Removed T intersection through road rule which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection because turns on red are especially hazardous to pedestrians.
corrections.note: Replaced red light green light rules with supported pedestrian yield rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: When an emergency vehicle approaches from behind using a siren or flashing lights you must immediately yield the right of way and safely pull to the right edge and stop until it has passed and you must yield to funeral processions.
corrections.note: Removed requirement to first leave an occupied intersection.

corrections.corrected_statement: When approaching a stationary emergency vehicle or tow truck with flashing lights change to a lane not next to the vehicle if reasonable otherwise reduce speed and proceed with caution.
corrections.note: Removed construction vehicles which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection.
corrections.note: Replaced walk countdown rules with supported pedestrian yield rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Enter a roundabout by slowing, yielding to every circulating lane, circling counterclockwise around the island, and yielding to crossing pedestrians.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but counterclockwise travel is stated on page eighteen.

corrections.corrected_statement: While inside a roundabout stay in your lane until ready to exit and use your right turn signal to show what you want to do.
corrections.note: Removed truck wide arc rule which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Before changing lanes check side and rearview mirrors and signal and quickly glance over your shoulder to check the blind spot.
corrections.note: Removed planning early speed setting and ramp speed rules.

corrections.corrected_statement: When passing return to the right lane as soon as you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
corrections.note: Changed headlights to front of the passed vehicle.

corrections.corrected_statement: Passing is unlawful on hills and curves and at intersections or railroad crossings except on roads with two or more lanes moving in the same direction.
corrections.note: Removed one hundred foot bridge tunnel and pedestrian crossing bans.

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not pass when a solid line marks the left side of your lane and complete the pass before a No Passing zone.
corrections.note: Replaced double yellow solid side wording with supported solid line rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: When the way is clear to make a left turn yield to any vehicles approaching from the opposite direction.
corrections.note: Removed green arrow owns right of way which no page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection and when entering from a private road or driveway stop and yield to all traffic and pedestrians.
corrections.note: Removed parking areas which no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: When vehicles arrive at the same time at an intersection with no signs or signals the driver on the left must allow the driver on the right to go first.
corrections.note: Removed T junction through road rule which no page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection because turns on red are especially hazardous to pedestrians.
corrections.note: Replaced red green still inside rules with supported yield rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing within a clearly marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection.
corrections.note: Replaced walk countdown rules with supported yield rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Roundabout entry yields to every circulating lane, while circulating means counterclockwise travel, signed lane choice, and a right-turn exit.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but counterclockwise travel is stated on page eighteen.

corrections.corrected_statement: While inside a roundabout stay in your lane until you are ready to exit.
corrections.note: Removed truck wide arc no driving beside rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Before changing lanes check side and rearview mirrors and signal and quickly glance over your shoulder to check the blind spot.
corrections.note: Removed ramp speed matching rule which no page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: When passing return when you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your mirror and do not pass on hills and curves or at intersections or when a school bus is stopped.
corrections.note: Changed headlights to front and removed pedestrian crossing ban.

corrections.corrected_statement: Passing is unlawful on hills and curves and at intersections or railroad crossings and you must complete the pass before a No Passing zone.
corrections.note: Removed structure double yellow solid side bans not stated.

corrections.corrected_statement: A licensed physician may waive the child restraint law for weight physical fitness or other medical reasons if the transporter carries the signed statement naming the child and the grounds and the driver is responsible with a fine of fifty dollars for a first violation and up to five hundred dollars for a second or later violation.
corrections.note: Changed certain five hundred dollar repeat fine to could mean up to five hundred dollars.

corrections.corrected_statement: Tell the officer where your license registration and insurance are and reach for them slowly with one hand on the wheel and you may ask for identification if the officer is unmarked or not in uniform and signing the citation is not guilt but refusal to sign may lead to arrest or a required trip to the station.
corrections.note: Changed certain arrest to may lead to arrest or station trip.

corrections.corrected_statement: A licensed physician may waive child restraints for weight physical fitness or other medical reasons with a signed statement carried and a first violation costs fifty dollars while a second or later violation could cost up to five hundred dollars.
corrections.note: Added physical fitness grounds and changed certain repeat fine to could cost.

corrections.corrected_statement: A rear facing seat may go in the front passenger seat only when there is no back seat and the passenger air bag is absent or turned off and children age twelve and under are safer buckled in the back seat.
corrections.note: Changed mandatory back seat rule to safer recommendation.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you are convicted of driving after illegally consuming alcohol with a blood alcohol concentration of point zero eight percent or higher you may face the same penalties as an adult.
corrections.note: Changed definite earns to may face to match page.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you are convicted of driving after illegally consuming alcohol with a blood alcohol concentration of point zero eight percent or higher you may face the same penalties as an adult, and if you provide or sell alcoholic beverages to a person under age twenty one you are subject to a fine and license suspension and jail time.
corrections.note: Changed definite adult penalties to may face same penalties as an adult.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you provide or sell alcoholic beverages to a person under age twenty one you are subject to a fine of up to twenty five hundred dollars and mandatory suspension for up to one year and twelve months in jail, while if you are under age twenty one and use a fake identification you will be fined at least five hundred dollars and required to perform at least fifty hours of community service and face up to twelve months in jail and face mandatory suspension for at least six months but not more than one year.
corrections.note: Added up to and at least qualifiers for fines jail service and suspension.

corrections.corrected_statement: International driving permits are issued by your local AAA except to persons whose driving privilege is suspended or revoked, and a visitor home country license should be accompanied by a translation of the license.
corrections.note: Changed must pair to should be accompanied.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you are age eighteen or older and you get twelve demerit points in twelve months or eighteen demerit points in twenty four months you must complete a driver improvement clinic within ninety days or your license will be suspended, and if you get eighteen demerit points in twelve months or twenty four demerit points in twenty four months your license will be suspended for ninety days and you must complete a driver improvement clinic.
corrections.note: Corrected that ninety days is the deadline to complete the clinic, not the suspension length for missing it.
